cleavage_agent.evidence: Subsequently, samples were digested under agitation at 37 °C for 3 h with 0.2 µg of rLysC (Promega, Sweden) after pH adjustment.
This was followed by overnight digestion with 0.8 µg of trypsin (Promega, Sweden) per sample.

collision_energy.evidence: Normalized collision energy was set at 33 and the isolation window was 0.8 m/z.

fractionation_method.evidence: As a part of future perspective for further depth in these types of samples we performed offline high pH fractionation in combination with TMT labelling and achieved ~30% more protein identifications and reduced costly mass spectrometry time.
The fractionation was performed using a Waters ACQUITY UPLC Peptide CSH C18 1.7 µm, 1 × 150 column on an UltimateMicro HPLC (Dionex, Sunnyvale, CA, USA).
